source.book: 剑桥KET青少版官方真题3（扫描版）
source.pages: 参考答案&音频文稿小册 PDF 1–9 页（书页 102–110，scripts/_ket_sch3_t3/page-001~009.png）

parts.1:
Test Three. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Look at question one.
One. What has the girl lost?
Dad: What are you looking for, Daisy? Have you lost your key again?
Daisy: I've got that, Dad. It's in my pocket.
Dad: OK.
Daisy: It's my scarf. I can't find it and I'll need it today. I left it in the kitchen yesterday, next to Mum's purse and it's not there now.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Two. What can the boy see from his bedroom window?
Girl: Don't you live in those flats near the river?
Boy: Yeah – we're on the top floor. We can see out over the whole city.
Girl: Lucky you! The view from my window's really boring.
Boy: Oh, well, I can't see it from my bedroom – that just has a view of a big car park. Why don't you come and visit one day?
Girl: Sure.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Three. What do they decide to eat?
Girl: Mum gave me some money so we can have lunch at the café in the shopping centre.
Boy: Oh, brilliant! They make delicious cheese sandwiches there.
Girl: Well, I really like the salads, but why don't we share a pizza today? I'm so hungry.
Boy: OK, great idea! I've never had one there. And I will probably have a salad tonight anyway.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Four. Where will Calum's birthday party be?
Boy: Where's Calum having his birthday party? He was talking about having a pool party at the sports centre.
Girl: Oh? Last time I spoke to him, he wanted to have a barbecue in his garden.
Boy: Oh, yes, you're right! He asked us to bring something to eat.
Girl: Yeah. I'm taking some burgers. He always has those when we go to the café.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Five. Where will the friends meet tomorrow?
Girl: Do you still want to go and see a film tomorrow?
Boy: Yeah! Shall I meet you outside the cinema? I'll get the tram.
Girl: Why don't I meet you at your tram stop when you get off, instead? It's always busy at the cinema.
Boy: Good idea. The stop's just round the corner from the library.
Girl: Great! See you there at three thirty.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling his class about an art competition.
Teacher: Hello everyone. I want to tell you about our next school art competition. All students who are aged between eleven and sixteen can enter the competition. Not just students in our year who are nearly all thirteen.
Now, the title for everyone's painting must be Buildings. These can be ones you know, like houses in our town. Or perhaps ones you've never visited like castles or palaces.
You can give your painting to the art teacher from the ninth of May, but you must give it to her by the eighteenth. And you'll learn who has won the competition on the twentieth of May.
We're lucky that a very special person will choose the winner. His name's Jacob Fossley. His surname's spelled F-O-double S-L-E-Y if you want to read about him online. He lives in our town, and he's a famous photographer.
And the prize? Not a laptop like the prize for the last competition, but a skateboard! This is because it's the most popular hobby at school!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear a girl, Martha, talking to her friend, Dan, about a class trip they have been on.
Dan: I think this year's school trip to the lake was much better than last year's to the sea, Martha.
Martha: Yeah Dan, the other class only went to the river.
Dan: We did so many activities. I loved horse riding. It was fun.
Martha: Oh? I especially liked riding our bikes on those paths. I'd really like to learn windsurfing some time.
Dan: Me too.
Martha: What was sailing like, Dan?
Dan: Well, the teacher explained everything clearly. There was a lot to learn and I kept forgetting what to do next. But, everyone helped each other.
Martha: That's nice.
Dan: You didn't go swimming, Martha. Didn't you take your swimming things?
Martha: I did, but it was such a cold day.
Dan: It was fine when I was in the water. But it was deep.
Martha: Oh, that's never a problem for me. I loved having the barbecue by the water.
Dan: I thought it was a bit dirty there actually.
Martha: Really? I didn't. But we had to leave so early.
Dan: I know. And people weren't bored … everyone was having such a great time.
Martha: Yeah.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear a girl talking about buying a present. What kind of present does she decide to buy?
Girl: My brother's bought Mum chocolates for her birthday. Her favourite kind! It's funny, I was going to buy those too, but I saw some earrings at that new market and I'm going to get them tomorrow. I'd left my purse at home today. It's an awesome market. My classmate, Ben, bought a really cool T-shirt there.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Seventeen. You will hear a boy leaving a message for his mother. What does he want her to do for him?
Boy: Hi, Mum. My bike's got a flat tyre and I must get my books back to the city library before 5:30. I've got extra athletics training which will finish too late for me to walk there. Could you possibly do it for me? They're on my desk. Thanks! I'll get you your favourite magazine on my way home.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Eighteen. You will hear a boy talking to his grandmother about his day at school. What did he enjoy most?
Granny: How was school today?
Boy: Not bad. Our history teacher showed us a documentary about life in Ancient Rome this morning.
Granny: Interesting.
Boy: A bit boring actually. At lunchtime we had a table-tennis competition. That was the best bit of the day. In the afternoon we started preparing for this year's concert but I'd forgotten my guitar so I couldn't do much.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Nineteen. You will hear two friends talking about the clubs they go to after school. What kind of club do they both enjoy going to?
Girl: There are brilliant clubs at this school!
Boy: I know! I love doing landscape painting after school on Thursdays.
Girl: I go to basketball then. It's fun.
Boy: Yeah. I do that on Wednesdays. And on Fridays I sing in the choir.
Girl: You are busy! I started playing the trumpet in a jazz band on Mondays as well but I've stopped now.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Twenty. You will hear two friends talking about a film. What didn't they like about the film?
Girl: I didn't really like that film yesterday.
Boy: I was disappointed too. The main actor was no good.
Girl: I know. He never is.
Boy: At least it wasn't too long!
Girl: You're right. I was pleased when it ended. But the story finished in quite an interesting way, I suppose.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Alice talking to her friend Jake about what some people in their class will do to help with the school play. What will each person do to help with the play?
Jake: Hi, Alice. Are you ready for the school play next week?
Alice: Yeah. I'm going to help give people tea and juice during the break, like I did last year.
Jake: Cool.
Alice: What about you, Jake?
Jake: Well, I wanted to help with selling tickets but there're lots of people already doing that, so I'm going to clean the room after everyone's finished. Make sure everything's in the right place.
Alice: That's a lot of work.
Jake: I don't mind.
Alice: Do you know if Suzy's taking the photos? She's really good at art.
Jake: I know, but she's decided to help with the make-up instead.
Alice: So will Dan take the pictures?
Jake: Yeah, he loves that. He says it's easier than tidying up!
Alice: So what's Lauren doing?
Jake: She usually makes the clothes. But this time she's doing the posters to put up round the school.
Alice: What will George do?
Jake: He's getting the room ready for the play. He doesn't like doing stuff like selling tickets.
Alice: OK.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 女孩 Daisy 找不到自己的围巾，因此选择 B。爸爸先问她 "Have you lost your key again?"，她答 "I've got that, Dad. It's in my pocket."，可见钥匙没丢；她接着说 "It's my scarf. I can't find it and I'll need it today."，丢的正是围巾。
explanations.p1q2: 男孩卧室的窗户可以看到一个大型停车场，因此选择 B。女孩以为他住在河边那栋楼 "in those flats near the river"，男孩也提到顶楼能看全城 "We can see out over the whole city"，但随后澄清卧室看不到那景色："I can't see it from my bedroom – that just has a view of a big car park."。
explanations.p1q3: 两人最后决定吃披萨，因此选择 A。男孩先夸三明治 "They make delicious cheese sandwiches there"，女孩虽然 "really like the salads"，但提议 "why don't we share a pizza today?"，男孩答应 "OK, great idea!"，所以最终吃的是披萨。
explanations.p1q4: 生日聚会将在带烧烤架的家中举行，因此选择 A。男孩起初猜是在体育中心开泳池派对 "having a pool party at the sports centre"，女孩纠正说他上次说过 "he wanted to have a barbecue in his garden"，男孩随即承认 "Oh, yes, you're right!"，所以聚会是在他家的花园（家里）。
explanations.p1q5: 朋友们约在电车站见面，因此选择 C。男孩先提议 "Shall I meet you outside the cinema?"，女孩改为 "Why don't I meet you at your tram stop when you get off, instead?"，男孩回应 "Good idea."，最终在男孩的电车站碰头；图书馆只是描述车站位置（"round the corner from the library"），不是见面点。
explanations.p2q1: 老师说所有人画作的标题必须是 "the title for everyone's painting must be Buildings"，因此填 Buildings；房子、城堡只是可以画的内容（"like houses in our town"、"castles or palaces"），不是标题本身。
explanations.p2q2: 老师说 5 月 9 日起就可以交画 "give your painting to the art teacher from the ninth of May"，但最晚必须 "give it to her by the eighteenth"，即 5 月 18 日前交；"on the twentieth of May" 是公布获胜者的日子。因此填 18 May。
explanations.p2q3: 老师说将由 "a very special person will choose the winner. His name's Jacob Fossley."，并拼读姓氏 "F-O-double S-L-E-Y"，故 Jacob 后面填 Fossley。
explanations.p2q4: 老师介绍这位评委 "He lives in our town, and he's a famous photographer."，职业是摄影师，因此填 photographer。
explanations.p2q5: 老师说今年的奖品 "Not a laptop like the prize for the last competition, but a skateboard!"，即不再是上届的笔记本电脑，而是滑板，因此填 skateboard。
explanations.p3q1: Dan 明确说今年的学校旅行去了 lake："I think this year's school trip to the lake was much better than last year's to the sea, Martha."；海边是去年的地点，河边是另一班去的地方（"the other class only went to the river"）。因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q2: Martha 虽然想将来学习帆板（"I'd really like to learn windsurfing some time"），但这次最喜欢的是在小路上骑自行车："I especially liked riding our bikes on those paths."。因此选择 A；"I loved horse riding. It was fun." 是 Dan 说的，马术是他的最爱，不是 Martha 的。
explanations.p3q3: Dan 困难的是不断忘记下一步该做什么："There was a lot to learn and I kept forgetting what to do next."；而老师讲得很清楚（"the teacher explained everything clearly"）、同学也互相帮助（"everyone helped each other"）。因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q4: Martha 带了游泳用品，也不怕深水（"that's never a problem for me"）；她认为当天太冷所以没游："I did, but it was such a cold day."。因此选择 B；带了泳具排除 C，不怕深水排除 A。
explanations.p3q5: Martha 说他们不得不很早离开（"But we had to leave so early."），Dan 也表示同意（"I know."）；两人都不认为活动无聊——Dan 说 "people weren't bored … everyone was having such a great time."。地点好坏两人并未一致认可（Dan 觉得 "a bit dirty"，Martha 回 "Really? I didn't."）。因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: 巧克力和 T 恤都只是被提到；女孩最后决定买耳环，因此是 jewellery。她说 "I saw some earrings at that new market and I'm going to get them tomorrow."；巧克力是弟弟已经买好的（"My brother's bought Mum chocolates"），T 恤是同学 Ben 买的（"bought a really cool T-shirt there"），都不是她的选择。
explanations.p4q2: 男孩自行车爆胎，来不及步行去图书馆："My bike's got a flat tyre and I must get my books back to the city library before 5:30."；他请妈妈帮忙 "Could you possibly do it for me?"，即代他还书，因此选择 C。爆胎的车没请妈妈修；他说 "I'll get you your favourite magazine" 是自己买杂志送妈妈，不是请妈妈买东西。
explanations.p4q3: 历史纪录片让他觉得有点无聊（"A bit boring actually"），下午也没带吉他（"I'd forgotten my guitar so I couldn't do much"）；午间乒乓球比赛才是他最喜欢的部分："At lunchtime we had a table-tennis competition. That was the best bit of the day."。因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q4: 两人都参加篮球活动：女孩说 "I go to basketball then."，男孩回应 "Yeah. I do that on Wednesdays."，共同的俱乐部是体育类，因此选择 A；风景绘画课只有男孩上（"I love doing landscape painting"），合唱只有男孩参加（"I sing in the choir"），爵士乐团只有女孩参加且已退出（"I've stopped now"）。
explanations.p4q5: 他们认为电影不长、结局也有趣；两人不喜欢的是男主角。男孩说 "I was disappointed too. The main actor was no good."，女孩附和 "I know. He never is."，因此选择 B；男孩说 "At least it wasn't too long!" 排除长度问题，女孩也觉得 "the story finished in quite an interesting way"，结局没问题。
explanations.p5q1: Jake 本想帮忙卖票，但 "there're lots of people already doing that"，于是改说自己 "I'm going to clean the room after everyone's finished. Make sure everything's in the right place."，即演出结束后打扫整理房间，对应 tidy up afterwards（H）。
explanations.p5q2: Alice 问 Suzy 是不是负责拍照（"Do you know if Suzy's taking the photos?"），Jake 说 "she's decided to help with the make-up instead."，所以 Suzy 负责化妆而非拍照，对应 do the make-up（B）。
explanations.p5q3: Alice 问 "So will Dan take the pictures?"，Jake 回答 "Yeah, he loves that."，所以 Dan 负责拍照，对应 be the photographer（A）；他只是说拍照比收拾轻松（"He says it's easier than tidying up!"），收拾房间是 Jake 自己的任务。
explanations.p5q4: Jake 说 Lauren 通常做服装，但这次改做海报："She usually makes the clothes. But this time she's doing the posters to put up round the school."，对应 make posters（D）。
explanations.p5q5: Jake 说 George "He's getting the room ready for the play."，即布置准备演出用的房间，对应 prepare the room（E）；他还提到 George "doesn't like doing stuff like selling tickets"，卖票不是 George 的任务。
